kurz: Baking powder is a mix of a base, an acid and a little starch. You can mix it yourself from baking soda and [[weinstein|cream of tartar]] in a minute.
bild_im_kopf: Like fireworks with the fuse packed separately: only once water is added does it go off.
ergebnis: About 4 tsp of baking powder, as much as one sachet. 1 tsp replaces 1 tsp of shop-bought baking powder.
haltbarkeit: A few weeks, dry and airtight. Moisture starts the reaction too early.
synonyme: baking soda and cream of tartar
verwendung: Cakes, muffins and pancakes when you have run out.
For people who want phosphate-free baking powder.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Mix baking soda, cream of tartar and starch while dry
schluesselmomente.warum: [[natron|Baking soda]] is the base, cream of tartar the acid. Dry, they do not react with each other.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Do not leave out the starch
schluesselmomente.warum: It takes up moisture from the air before the acid and base do, and keeps the mix free-flowing.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Stir into the batter with the liquid and bake straight away
schluesselmomente.warum: With water, acid and base react and form [[kohlendioxid|carbon dioxide]]. This mix gets going at once, so do not wait.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Test freshness: sprinkle a little into hot water
schluesselmomente.warum: If it foams vigorously, it is still active.
